_readme: S721 lever (the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever, run 45371224551): MiraCosta College's 5 programs whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses, each read from its discipline page: Architectural Design A.A. 07863 (disciplines/design/), Child Development Teacher A.A. 15183 and certificate 22006 (disciplines/childdevelopment/, where the state lists CDEV 212 alone), and Tech Support A.S. 36144 and certificate 36171 (disciplines/computerstudiesandinformationtechnology/). This plan reads the three discipline pages as the capture reads them (capture_view: the visible text with the hidden tab panels appended), prints their links beneath the discipline, and follows up to five award pages, so a session sees whether each program has a page of its own and where its heading and list fall. No model call, nothing written.

questions.own_page: Which page is each program's own (its heading with its award and its requirement list), and what the discipline page prints of it.
